src:
ENABLE INTERRUPT

; ===== registers =====
namereg s0, bitcnt
namereg s1, datareg
namereg s2, temp
namereg s3, ledsw

            load bitcnt, 00
            load datareg, 00

main_loop:
            compare bitcnt, 0A
            jump nz, main_loop

            input ledsw, 01
            compare ledsw, 00
            jump z, low_nibble

high_nibble:
            load temp, datareg
            sr0 temp
            sr0 temp
            sr0 temp
            sr0 temp
            output temp, 05
            load bitcnt, 00
            jump main_loop

low_nibble:
            load temp, datareg
            and temp, 0F
            output temp, 05
            load bitcnt, 00
            jump main_loop


; ===== interrupt routine =====
int_rut:

            input temp, 02

            compare bitcnt, 00
            jump z, int_start

            compare bitcnt, 09
            jump z, int_parity

            compare bitcnt, 0A
            jump z, int_stop

int_data:
            sr1 datareg
            compare temp, 01
            jump nz, data_zero
            or datareg, 80
data_zero:
            add bitcnt, 01
            returni enable

int_start:
            add bitcnt, 01
            returni enable

int_parity:
            add bitcnt, 01
            returni enable

int_stop:
            load bitcnt, 0A
            returni enable


; ===== interrupt vector =====
            address 3FF
            jump int_rut
